body: As I approach the buoy, the icy chill of the glassy water envelops me, making my skin shiver. The buoy itself looms large and ominous, its dark metal looming in the pale light. I try to rationalize my fear, telling myself it's just a piece of equipment, nothing more, but my gut screams otherwise. The urge to move is overwhelming. I quicken my pace, feeling a surge of adrenaline coursing through my veins.
